framework_support.name: vanilla
framework_support.notes: Bundled HTML/CSS/JavaScript sample and scoped CSS. Native means direct web asset use, not native OS integration.

framework_support.name: react
framework_support.notes: Map scoped tokens/styles onto existing React primitives; no bundled React component library.

framework_support.name: vue
framework_support.notes: Adapt styles and states to existing Vue components; no React dependency.

framework_support.name: electron
framework_support.notes: Renderer styling only; tray/window lifecycle requires host-specific implementation and testing.

framework_support.name: tauri
framework_support.notes: WebView styling only; native tray and panel behavior is not provided by the sample.

framework_support.name: swiftui-appkit
framework_support.notes: Visual tokens and native behavior guidance, not tested Swift components.

framework_support.name: winui
framework_support.notes: Map visual semantics to platform controls; native tray integration is not bundled.

framework_support.name: qt
framework_support.notes: Token/layout guidance; no bundled Qt widgets.
